title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
reason: Major funding round for a frontier AI lab at a record valuation, indicating significant market shifts.

sources.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.

title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
reason: Major exchange withdrawing from key European markets, impacting user access and regulatory landscape.

sources.summary: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.
